description: SWG color preset, default = PackedRgb (D-09): 3 x u8 = r, g, b (3 bytes). The most common leaf color form. SWG stores color THREE ways (3xu8 / packed u32-ARGB / 4xf32-ARGB); a chunk that disagrees is a one-click preset swap to colorArgb32 or colorArgbF, not an engine change. Source: PackedRgb.h public uint8 r,g,b; AffectorColor.cpp:170-172 reads r,g,b; :192-194 writes r,g,b. Pure JSON sugar over the kernel (D-08).
